method: Same ECE/reliability methodology as ADR-0004 (classifier_eval.py::calibration_analysis), applied to the multi-label OvR model's raw (uncalibrated) output, compared against the shipped baseline's already-calibrated ECE.

verdict: ECE numerically better than the shipped calibrated baseline on both repos, but k8s flips direction (mild overconfidence vs. the original severe-underconfidence pattern) -- a real semantic change, not a silent equivalent swap. Proposed fix: re-fit temperature scaling on the multi-label model's top-1 confidence stream before shipping -- see ADR-0036 cutover plan step 1, not yet implemented.
